blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Loren Legarda is urging local government units (LGUs) to open free public cooling centers in barangay halls and other accessible community facilities, and partner with shopping malls to provide relief from dangerous heat as a very strong El Niño threatens the health of vulnerable Filipinos. The proposal forms the sixth point of her 10-Point Policy Action Plan against El Niño, launched on Oct. 19. It aims to provide safe places where residents can cool down, rest, and get drinking water, particularly those without air-conditioning at home and workers who spend long hours outdoors. “If you have air-conditioning at […]...
